proposed_protocol.name: Tyrell handoff draft 2

identifiers.epoch_and_request: nonzero uint64 decimal, no leading zeroes, wrap or reuse

proposed_protocol.expiry_authority: ownership authority monotonic clock from accepted request; serialized against durable release

authority.vt_participant: dedicated nonroot service; scoped CAP_SYS_TTY_CONFIG and manager-opened tty0
authority.audio_participant: normal user in target audio session
authority.receipt_issuer: authority only, after durable composite release

invariants.requirement: No managed resource acquisition before bound draft-2 negotiation; protocol 1 remains refused.
Atomically seal acquisitions and actor registry before quiesce; register accepted work before side effects.
Hold every operation permit through side effect, backend completion and required readback.
Timeout, EOF, process/service exit, signals and client handle closure never constitute release.
Journal complete composite release before receipt or conflicting successor grant.
Bind authority incarnation, app instance, epoch, lease, request and operation; never reuse or wrap IDs.
Cancellation/resume intent drains current epoch before a fresh grant can rebuild.
Reconstruct unresolved accepted intents as unknown after restart; no reset-to-empty barrier.
Untracked legacy writers and pending cleanup exclude managed admission; old M5 endpoints retain behavior.
New managed restoration requires an authority permit; in-flight permitted effects retain the barrier through quarantine; no old restoration can remain after epoch release.
Accepted server load remains outstanding until positively resolved; finite scans cannot prove no late load.
Unresolved driver/server work keeps affected domains quarantined; no timing-based escape.
Completed lock/blank/mute claims require qualified effective cutoff, not just signals or missing frames.
Design review and legacy regressions do not qualify future protocol, runtime, package or hardware.

implementation_increments.deliverable: Bound draft-2 channel, authenticated bootstrap, durable operation ledger and barrier; inert adapters.
Separate observable v2 VT/audio participants and pending-operation reconciliation.
Managed KMS/LCD ownership/destructor policy and backend completion evidence.
Single-owner media actor, nonblocking control and preserved checkpoint semantics.
Qualified asynchronous shell integration, package/device acceptance, then Video idle optimization.

future_acceptance_cases.expected: Refuse before resources; no protocol downgrade.

future_acceptance_cases.trigger: NULL transition remains blocked beyond control deadline
future_acceptance_cases.expected: Fail request; retain registered graph and resource quarantine.

future_acceptance_cases.trigger: Queued HDMI/audio acquisition reaches authority after sealing
future_acceptance_cases.expected: Reject unaccepted work; retain already accepted intent in barrier.

future_acceptance_cases.trigger: Revocation occurs after an operation permit and before ioctl completion
future_acceptance_cases.expected: Withhold successor grant through completion/readback; no epoch-check TOCTOU.

future_acceptance_cases.trigger: App local-done arrives while VT/audio/stop-post still pending
future_acceptance_cases.expected: No composite receipt, commit or successor grant.

future_acceptance_cases.trigger: Cancellation arrives during VT takeover or accepted module load
future_acceptance_cases.expected: Drain and undo identified work before new grant; preserve intent.

future_acceptance_cases.trigger: Audio owner dies after server accepted load but before callback
future_acceptance_cases.expected: Keep unknown operation/quarantine; an absence scan is insufficient.

future_acceptance_cases.trigger: Saved VT or module identity conflicts with current external owner
future_acceptance_cases.expected: Preserve foreign state; invalidate and require reconciliation.
Return recorded result or reject; no new side effects or grant.

future_acceptance_cases.trigger: Resume arrives while old epoch is draining
future_acceptance_cases.expected: Finish release, allocate fresh epoch, then rebuild checkpoint.

future_acceptance_cases.trigger: Authority dies with accepted operation and durable intent
future_acceptance_cases.expected: New incarnation reconstructs unknown barrier; no inferred zero.

future_acceptance_cases.trigger: Ownership journal is missing/corrupt after uncertain work
future_acceptance_cases.expected: Disable managed domain pending controlled recovery.

future_acceptance_cases.trigger: ExecStopPost runs after app local release
future_acceptance_cases.expected: Join authoritative barrier; no independent late VT/module mutation.

future_acceptance_cases.trigger: App stops submitting while fbdev/driver update remains queued
future_acceptance_cases.expected: No LCD release/cutoff claim until qualified completion.

future_acceptance_cases.trigger: Legacy helper or APPLaunch writer is still active or cleaning up
future_acceptance_cases.expected: Reject managed admission; mode switch requires verified empty barrier.

future_acceptance_cases.trigger: Kernel display/audio operation remains unresolved during lock
future_acceptance_cases.expected: Do not claim completed lock/blank/mute; retain quarantine.

future_acceptance_cases.trigger: All registered participants drain and release is durably committed
future_acceptance_cases.expected: Fresh grant required; preserve checkpoint/track/retry state and clear stale input.

future_acceptance_cases.trigger: KMS/VT/audio cleanup returns failure or completion cannot be observed
future_acceptance_cases.expected: Retain failure/unknown; never synthesize a success receipt.

future_acceptance_cases.trigger: Release completion and timeout contend, or a committed receipt is delivered late
future_acceptance_cases.expected: One authority orders the durable terminal result; replay release if it won, otherwise quarantine and require a separate recovery transaction.

legacy_host_regressions.scope: unchanged legacy implementations; does not test the proposed protocol or authority

cpp_lease_and_audio_clients.backend: temporary Unix sockets and self-spawned fake launcher; no systemd, VT, DRM or audio server
cpp_lease_and_audio_clients.limitation: Confirms unchanged legacy client behavior, not v2 completion or ownership.

requires: exact new M5 package launch and return
ownership loss, shell/authority/helper crash and SIGTERM
responsiveness, privacy cutoff and backend completion on exact BSP
